rules.quote: There shall be a front yard of not less than 20% of the depth of the lot, but such front yard need not exceed 20 feet
rules.scope: Candidate rule, not an approval. Applies to a conventional new main building for a one-family dwelling on an R1-1 lot outside a Hillside Area or Coastal Zone, under LAMC 12.08 C.1. Supported expression: minimum front yard = min(0.2 * lot_depth_ft, 20). Lot depth is measured as defined in 12.03. The same 12.08 C.1 paragraph replaces this baseline with a prevailing front-yard average when developed lots with front yards varying by no more than ten feet make up 40% or more of the frontage, and that average can reach 40 feet. Key lots follow a separate computation. The baseline expression is valid only after frontage review confirms neither branch applies. Every exclusion must be checked, never presumed.
exclusions: special approvals (variances, adjustments, specific plans, HPOZ, subdivision or other discretionary conditions)
frontage averaging of developed lots comprising 40% or more of the frontage (12.08 C.1)
key lots (12.08 C.1 second paragraph)
sloping front lots (12.22 C.6)
unit development of a frontage (12.22 C.8)
established building or setback lines (12.22 C.1)
lots affected by acquisition for public use (12.22 C.13)
through lots (12.22 C.19) and flag lots

rules.quote: For a main building not more than two stories in height, there shall be a side yard on each side of the building of not less than 5 feet, except that where the lot is less than 50 feet in width, the side yard may be reduced to 10 percent of the width of the lot, but in no event to less than 3 feet in width.
rules.scope: Candidate rule, not an approval. Applies to new construction of an R1-1 main building outside a Hillside Area or Coastal Zone. Supported expression: required side yard on each side = base + ceil(max(0, building_height_ft - 18) / 10). The base is 5 when lot_width_ft >= 50, and max(3, 0.1 * lot_width_ft) when lot_width_ft < 50. The quoted 12.08 C.2.(a) passage supplies the base only. The height increment comes from 12.08 C.2.(b) in the same source, which says that for new construction of a main building on a lot outside a Hillside Area or Coastal Zone, one foot is added to each required side yard for each ten feet or fraction thereof above the first 18 feet. This replaces the per-story increment in (a). That clause is not inside the quoted passage, so it needs separate citation review. The 50-foot width test uses lot width as defined in 12.03. Every exclusion must be checked, never presumed.
exclusions: special approvals, and side yard requirements in specific plans, HPOZs or subdivision approvals that take precedence (12.08 C.2.(c))
side wall offset/plane break requirement for walls over 14 feet high and longer than 45 feet (12.08 C.2.(a)); not resolved by this rule
occupied rooftop deck setback (12.08 C.2.(d))
reduced side yards for frontages developed as a unit (12.22 C.9)
side yard waiver for a first-story garage (12.22 C.2)
established building or setback lines (12.22 C.1)
lots affected by acquisition for public use (12.22 C.13)
through lots (12.22 C.19) and flag lots
unresolved_references: 12.08 C.2.(b): source of the height-based increment, outside the quoted passage; cite and verify separately

rules.quote: There shall be a rear yard of not less than 15 feet in depth.
rules.scope: Candidate rule, not an approval. Applies to a conventional new main building on an R1-1 lot outside a Hillside Area or Coastal Zone, under LAMC 12.08 C.3. Supported expression: minimum rear yard = 15. 12.22 C.10 states that in R1 the rear yard does not include half of an abutting alley. Every exclusion must be checked, never presumed.
exclusions: special approvals (variances, adjustments, specific plans, HPOZ, subdivision or other discretionary conditions)
established building or setback lines (12.22 C.1)
lots affected by acquisition for public use (12.22 C.13)
through lots split into two building sites (12.22 C.19) and flag lots
unit developments

rules.quote: In the R1, RS, or RE9 Zones, no Building or Structure shall exceed 33 feet in height; except that when the roof of the uppermost Story of a Building or Structure or portion of the Building or Structure has a Slope of less than 25 percent, the maximum height shall be 28 feet.
rules.scope: Candidate rule, not an approval. Applies under LAMC 12.21.1 to an R1 lot in Height District No. 1 that is not in a Hillside Area or Coastal Zone. Supported expression: maximum height = 28 if roof_slope_percent < 25, otherwise 33. The source applies the 28-foot limit when the uppermost-story roof of the building, or of any portion of it, has a slope below 25 percent. A single roof_slope_percent input is therefore valid only if it is the lowest uppermost-story roof slope of any portion. A mixed roof without that confirmation is unresolved. The same section lets a block-average height replace this limit when 40% or more of one-family dwellings fronting both sides of the block exceed it. It also gives Specific Plan, HPOZ and subdivision height limits precedence, and the R1-1 suffix must be confirmed to carry no 1-L, 1-VL, 1-XL or 1-SS designation. Every exclusion must be checked, never presumed.
exclusions: special approvals, and height limits in Specific Plans, HPOZs or subdivision approvals that take precedence (12.21.1)
block-average height when 40% or more of existing one-family dwellings exceed the limit (12.21.1)
R1V, R1F and R1R zone variations (12.21.6)
Height District 1-L, 1-VL, 1-XL or 1-SS designations (12.21.1 A.1)
roof decks, and solar structures shading roof decks (12.21.1 B.3.(c))
roof structures and equipment allowances (12.21.1 B.3)
adjoining-grade exception (12.21.1 B.2)
unresolved_references: 12.03 definitions of Height of Building, Grade and Slope: not supplied
roof slope of any building portion vs. single roof_slope_percent input

rules.quote: For lots outside of a Hillside Area or Coastal Zone, the maximum Residential Floor Area contained in all buildings and accessory buildings shall not exceed 45 percent of the lot area (a Residential Floor Area ratio of 0.45).
rules.scope: Candidate rule, not an approval. Applies to an R1-1 lot outside a Hillside Area or Coastal Zone, under LAMC 12.08 C.5.(a). Supported expression: maximum Residential Floor Area = 0.45 * lot_area_sqft. The cap counts all buildings and accessory buildings on the lot, not only the main building. Floor area must be measured as Residential Floor Area under 12.03, where areas with ceilings over 14 feet count twice. The supplied 12.03 text is truncated partway through its exemptions. This cap does not resolve the encroachment plane that starts at 20 feet above grade along the required front and side yards. Every exclusion must be checked, never presumed.
exclusions: special approvals (variances, specific plans, HPOZ, subdivision or other discretionary conditions)
encroachment plane (12.08 C.5.(a)); not resolved by the floor area cap
R1V, R1F, R1R and R1H zone variations (12.08 C.5.(b)-(e))
existing floor area verification for additions and remodels (12.08 C.6)
lots affected by acquisition for public use (12.22 C.13)
through lots (12.22 C.19) and flag lots
unit developments
unresolved_references: 12.03 Residential Floor Area definition: supplied text truncated during exemptions (required covered parking and later items)
